facts: Parties: Calloway Logistics plc (Buyer), Northgate Software Ltd (Seller); the Company is Oakhurst Energy plc.
This Agreement is dated 13 February 2027; Closing is scheduled for 22 April 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.

Section 9.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $27,000,000. The Purchase Price is $225,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Marlow Industries Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.
